```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

This script documents how all vignette and testing data for the ECLIPSE
package was made. The Seurat object was from Braun et al., Cancer Cell, 2021,
as were the all_contig_annotations.csv files. The doi for this paper is
10.1016/j.ccell.2021.02.013. The data can be found on dbGaP
with accession phs002252.v2.p1. The following pieces of data are
generated below:

1. A vignette Seurat object that has 250 randomly selected cells per patient
from 2 patients with RCC, each with a tumor and normal sample 
(4 total samples). 
The RNA data in this object is synthetic, however, as it is not used in our
package. By changing most of the RNA counts to 0, this saves space. However,
this is intended to represent a real dataset, even if small.
2. The 4 all_contig_annotations.csv files that hold the TCR contigs for the
1000 cells in the vignette Seurat object.
3. A test Seurat object that has 5 randomly selected cells per patient from 
2 patients with RCC. Only 2 genes are retained in this object to save space.
This object is intended to be a minimal Seurat object that should only be used
to confirm that ECLIPSE will run.
4. The 2 all_contig_annotations.csv files that hold the TCR contigs for the 
10 cells in the test Seurat object.
5. The test Seurat object from #3, but then ECLIPSE is ran on it.
6. Post-QC TCR contigs generated by ECLIPSE on the same cells used to make the
test Seurat object from #3.






```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(Seurat)
library(ECLIPSE)
set.seed(16)
```

```{r}
############################################################################
###                         Pre-Processing                               ###
############################################################################

### This generates a Seurat object that ECLIPSE is ran on. This Seurat 
### object is NOT included in the package, as it is far too big. Instead,
### this is used to select cell barcodes that can be used for the vignette
### and testing data.

braun <- readRDS(paste0("/gpfs/boyd/pi/pi_db2475/lab_data/sc_assays/",
    "braun_cancer_cell_2021/processed/braun_cancer_cell_seurat.rds"))

braun@meta.data <- braun@meta.data %>% 
    separate(Sample, into = c("donor", "tissue"), remove = FALSE, sep = "_")
braun@meta.data <- braun@meta.data %>% 
    mutate(tissue = case_when(
        tissue %in% c("T", "T2") ~ "Tumor",
        tissue == "N" ~ "Normal",
        tissue %in% c("M", "V")  ~ "Other"))

cd8 <- subset(braun, subset = ClusterName_TCells %in% 
    c("Treg", "Activated CD4.1", "Activated CD4.2", "CD4 TCM.1", 
        "CD4 TCM.2", "Mito-high T cells", "-1"), invert = TRUE)

dirs <- list.files(paste0("/gpfs/boyd/pi/pi_db2475/lab_data/sc_assays/",
    "braun_cancer_cell_2021/raw/TCR/cellranger_output"), recursive = TRUE, 
    pattern = "all_contig_annotations\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
dirs <- dirs[!str_detect(dirs, "SC_VDJ_ASSEMBLER_CS")]
dirs <- str_replace(dirs, "all.*$", "")

matching <- read.csv(paste0("/gpfs/boyd/pi/pi_db2475/ecb86/sc_datasets/",
    "braun_cancer_cell/braun_matching2.csv"))
matching <- matching %>% filter(Sample != "")

cd8@meta.data <- cd8@meta.data %>% left_join(matching[, 2:3], by = "Sample")
cd8@meta.data <- as.data.frame(cd8@meta.data)
rownames(cd8@meta.data) <- cd8$Cell_barcode
cd8$Cell_Barcode <- str_replace(cd8$Cell_barcode, "\\-.*$", "-1")

cd8$ClusterName_TCells[cd8$ClusterName_TCells == 
    "PMCH+ terminally Exhausted CD8.1"] <- 
    "PMCH+ terminally \n Exhausted CD8.1"
cd8$ClusterName_TCells[cd8$ClusterName_TCells == 
    "Terminally exhausted CD8.2"] <- 
    "Terminally \n exhausted CD8.2"
cd8$ClusterName_TCells[cd8$ClusterName_TCells == 
    "Terminally exhausted CD8.3"] <- 
    "Terminally \n exhausted CD8.3"

table(cd8$Sample)

obj <- ECLIPSE(contig_folder_paths = dirs, 
    contig_type = "all", 
    seurat_object = cd8, 
    batch = "index", 
    donor = "donor", 
    group = "donor", 
    original_barcode = "Cell_Barcode", 
    detailedEclipseStats = TRUE, 
    combineTcrArgs = list(FALSE, FALSE, TRUE, TRUE))
```

```{r} 
### Making vignette Seurat object and 4 all_contig_files
s3tbc <- as.character(obj$Cell_barcode[!is.na(obj$CTaa) & 
    obj$Sample == "S3_T"])
s3nbc <- as.character(obj$Cell_barcode[!is.na(obj$CTaa) & 
    obj$Sample == "S3_N"])
s15tbc <- as.character(obj$Cell_barcode[!is.na(obj$CTaa) & 
    obj$Sample == "S15_T"])
s15nbc <- as.character(obj$Cell_barcode[!is.na(obj$CTaa) & 
    obj$Sample == "S15_N"])

s3t <- sample(s3tbc, replace = FALSE, size = 250)
s3n <- sample(s3nbc, replace = FALSE, size = 250)
s15t <- sample(s15tbc, replace = FALSE, size = 250)
s15n <- sample(s15nbc, replace = FALSE, size = 250)

keep_bc <- c(s3t, s3n, s15t, s15n)

mini <- subset(cd8, Cell_barcode %in% keep_bc)


meta <- mini@meta.data %>% select(nCount_RNA, Cell_barcode, donor, Sample)

fake <- matrix(rep(0, 2000), nrow = 2)
rownames(fake) <- c("CD3E", "CD8A")
fake[1, 1] <- 1
colnames(fake) <- keep_bc
data2 <- as(fake, "dgCMatrix")

fake_seurat <- CreateSeuratObject(data2, min.cells = 0, min.features = 0)
fake_seurat$Cell_barcode <- rownames(fake_seurat@meta.data)
fake_seurat@meta.data <- fake_seurat@meta.data[,-c(2:3)]
fake_seurat@meta.data <- fake_seurat@meta.data %>% 
    left_join(meta, by = "Cell_barcode", keep = FALSE)

fake_seurat@meta.data <- as.data.frame(fake_seurat@meta.data)
rownames(fake_seurat@meta.data) <- fake_seurat$Cell_barcode

s3t_tcr <- read.csv(paste0("/gpfs/boyd/pi/pi_db2475/lab_data/sc_assays/",
    "braun_cancer_cell_2021/raw/TCR/cellranger_output/Pool1-19/outs/",
    "all_contig_annotations.csv"))
s3n_tcr <- read.csv(paste0("/gpfs/boyd/pi/pi_db2475/lab_data/sc_assays/",
    "braun_cancer_cell_2021/raw/TCR/cellranger_output/Pool2-1/outs/",
    "all_contig_annotations.csv"))
s15t_tcr <- read.csv(paste0("/gpfs/boyd/pi/pi_db2475/lab_data/sc_assays/",
    "braun_cancer_cell_2021/raw/TCR/cellranger_output/Pool2-19/outs/",
    "all_contig_annotations.csv"))
s15n_tcr <- read.csv(paste0("/gpfs/boyd/pi/pi_db2475/lab_data/sc_assays/",
    "braun_cancer_cell_2021/raw/TCR/cellranger_output/Pool3-1/outs/",
    "all_contig_annotations.csv"))

s3t_tcr <- s3t_tcr %>% filter(barcode %in% str_replace(s3t, "-.*$", "-1"))
s3n_tcr <- s3n_tcr %>% filter(barcode %in% str_replace(s3n, "-.*$", "-1"))
s15t_tcr <- s15t_tcr %>% filter(barcode %in% str_replace(s15t, "-.*$", "-1"))
s15n_tcr <- s15n_tcr %>% filter(barcode %in% str_replace(s15n, "-.*$", "-1"))

write_csv(s3t_tcr, paste0("/home/ecb86/Desktop/ECLIPSE/package/inst/",
    "extdata/vignette/S3T/all_contig_annotations.csv.gz"))
write_csv(s3n_tcr, paste0("/home/ecb86/Desktop/ECLIPSE/package/inst/",
    "extdata/vignette/S3N/all_contig_annotations.csv.gz"))
write_csv(s15t_tcr, paste0("/home/ecb86/Desktop/ECLIPSE/package/inst/",
    "extdata/vignette/S15T/all_contig_annotations.csv.gz"))
write_csv(s15n_tcr, paste0("/home/ecb86/Desktop/ECLIPSE/package/inst/",
    "extdata/vignette/S15N/all_contig_annotations.csv.gz"))

vignette_object <- fake_seurat
usethis::use_data(vignette_object, overwrite = TRUE)
```

```{r}
### Making slim object and contig files for it.
### Note, this is much smaller than the vignette object to increase
### run times. That object is 1000 cells, while this one is only 10 cells.
slim <- subset(cd8, Sample %in% c("S12_T", "S14_T"))

pool210 <- c("AAAGCAAAGCGTAGTG-1", "AAATGCCTCGGAATCT-1", 
    "AACCATGAGTGTGGCA-1", "AAGGAGCCACAACTGT-1",
    "ACACTGACATTTCACT-1")
pool217 <- c("AACTCCCTCGTACCGG-1", "ACGAGCCAGACTCGGA-1", 
    "AACTCTTAGTACGCCC-1", "ACATGGTTCGAGCCCA-1", 
    "CAGTAACTCTAACCGA-1")

contigs210 <- read.csv(paste0("/gpfs/boyd/pi/pi_db2475/lab_data/sc_assays/",
    "braun_cancer_cell_2021/raw/TCR/cellranger_output/Pool2-10/",
    "outs/all_contig_annotations.csv"))
contigs217 <- read.csv(paste0("/gpfs/boyd/pi/pi_db2475/lab_data/sc_assays/",
    "braun_cancer_cell_2021/raw/TCR/cellranger_output/Pool2-17/",
    "outs/all_contig_annotations.csv"))

sum(pool210 %in% slim$Cell_Barcode)
sum(pool217 %in% slim$Cell_Barcode)

slim210 <- contigs210 %>% filter(barcode %in% pool210)
slim217 <- contigs217 %>% filter(barcode %in% pool217)

slim2 <- subset(cd8, Cell_Barcode %in% c(pool210, pool217) & 
    Sample %in% c("S12_T", "S14_T"))
                
nrow(slim2@meta.data)

meta <- slim2@meta.data %>% select(Cell_barcode, Cell_Barcode, donor, index)
meta$index[meta$index == 13] <- 1
meta$index[meta$index == 20] <- 2

data <- slim2@assays[["RNA"]]@counts[c("CD3D", "CD8A"), ]
slim3 <- CreateSeuratObject(data)
slim3@meta.data <- slim3@meta.data %>% 
    select(-nFeature_RNA) %>%
    mutate(Cell_barcode = rownames(slim3@meta.data))

slim3@meta.data <- slim3@meta.data %>% left_join(meta, by = "Cell_barcode")
slim3@meta.data <- as.data.frame(slim3@meta.data)
rownames(slim3@meta.data) <- slim3$Cell_barcode

test_seurat <- slim3


write_csv(slim210, paste0("/home/ecb86/Desktop/ECLIPSE/package/inst/",
    "extdata/examples/S12_all_contig_annotations.csv.gz"))
write_csv(slim217, paste0("/home/ecb86/Desktop/ECLIPSE/package/inst/",
    "extdata/examples/S14_all_contig_annotations.csv.gz"))

usethis::use_data(test_seurat, overwrite = TRUE)
```

```{r}
#### Making the post-QC contigs and test Seurat object after 
### ECLIPSE was ran on it
contig_files <- c(paste0("/home/ecb86/Desktop/ECLIPSE/package/inst/",
    "extdata/examples/S12_all_contig_annotations.csv.gz"),
        paste0("/home/ecb86/Desktop/ECLIPSE/package/inst/",
    "extdata/examples/S14_all_contig_annotations.csv.gz"))

data('test_seurat')

cd8_tcr <- ECLIPSE(contig_file_paths = contig_files, 
    contig_type = "manual", 
    seurat_object = test_seurat, 
    batch = "index", 
    donor = "donor", 
    group = "donor", 
    original_barcode = "Cell_Barcode", 
    combineTcrArgs = list(FALSE, FALSE, FALSE, TRUE))

test_seurat_with_tcr <- cd8_tcr
usethis::use_data(test_seurat_with_tcr, overwrite = TRUE)

post_qc_contigs <- ECLIPSE(contig_file_paths = contig_files, 
    contig_type = "manual", 
    seurat_object = test_seurat, 
    batch = "index", 
    donor = "donor", 
    group = "donor", 
    original_barcode = "Cell_Barcode", 
    combineTcrArgs = list(FALSE, FALSE, FALSE, TRUE),
    returnFilteredContigs = TRUE)

usethis::use_data(post_qc_contigs, overwrite = TRUE)
```
